body.text: Crypto News Bot — Daily Digest
August 4, 2026
Stablecoin supply has shed $15B since May, 2026's biggest decline since Terra's collapse, as GENIUS Act interest bans push cash into tokenized Treasuries.
Stablecoin News
Stablecoin supply posts biggest drop since Terra
Total supply fell over $15B from a mid-May peak of $322B as GENIUS Act rules barring yield on payment stablecoins pushed cash into tokenized Treasuries. USDT and USDC absorbed most of the decline.
OCC issues proposed rules to implement GENIUS Act
The OCC published a notice of proposed rulemaking covering issuance and licensing requirements for payment stablecoin issuers, a major step in formalizing the July 2025 law.
Tether and Circle battle for share as new rival emerges
Circle's Arc chain is moving to proof-of-stake and courting institutions, while Stripe, Visa, BlackRock and 140+ firms back a new rival, Open USD (OUSD); Circle shares fell 13% on the news.
Tether's USAT grows but still trails USDC, PYUSD, RLUSD
Tether's US-focused stablecoin USAT is scaling for institutional treasury and settlement use, but remains far smaller than Circle's ~$72B USDC and other regulated rivals.
Hacking & Security Incidents
Coldcard hardware wallet flaw drains $116M in BTC

A 2021 firmware bug routed seed generation to a predictable software RNG instead of the hardware RNG; attackers have swept over 4,500 wallets in successive waves since July 30. Coinkite has shipped emergency firmware.
Ethereum phishing scam drains nearly $1M from a single wallet
A targeted phishing attack tricked a victim into signing a malicious transaction, draining close to $1M in ETH-based assets in one hit.
KelpDAO's $292M LayerZero bridge hack still reverberating

The April cross-chain exploit, linked to North Korea's Lazarus Group, triggered a $9B panic withdrawal from Aave after attackers used stolen funds as loan collateral, exposing systemic DeFi contagion risk.
H1 2026 sets record for crypto hack frequency
Q2 2026 logged roughly 70 separate exploits, the most-hacked quarter on record, though total losses stayed below $1B as recovery efforts improved.
